features: Before You Start onboarding screen (third screen, after Welcome + Notifications) — four questions that set the Settings defaults: quality (Ask each time first, then 1080p/720p/480p/360p), Sub/Dub/Ask, subs (Hard / Soft / Both works, Recommended), and size (Best quality / Smallest file / Fastest first). Frieren art pans left to right (Frieren to Fern to Stark) with the settled motion: screen 1.4s, question 1.35s, heading glide 1.7s, background pan 2.6s. Skippable, defaults kept. Existing users see ONLY this screen once after updating — never Welcome, never the notification re-prompt.

Subs and size are now tri-states: Hard subs races direct files first (HLS fallback), Soft subs races streams first (direct fallback), Both works is today's parallel race; Best quality is a new largest-file race mode (mirror of smallest-file), Fastest first is both size options off. Each phased race waits a bounded 8s for its preferred kind before falling back, so the no-match case doesn't get slower.

New Sources section in Settings holding quality default, language default, subs tri-state, size tri-state, preferred server, sources order, and auto-test last. Downloads keeps queue, folder, and behaviour only.
fixes: Reverted the per-server file sizes experiment from dev2.13 — the download sheet is back to the dev2.12 behaviour: one size line for the winning server plus the Server chips (Auto / Server 1…10). The collect-all race that filled the per-server list was cancelling its own racers, so the sheet could end up saying "No server has a file at 1080p Sub" for episodes that do have one. Everything else from dev2.12 stays: the updater fix, Server 10, the 10 Sources pill, and both Settings toggles
Ask each time quality/language: the sheets open with nothing picked and block the download with a toast until you choose; list warming, batch, and season downloads fall back to 1080p/Sub
About page now credits AniList alongside AniLab (AniLab: titles/posters/search/home; AniList: episode-count fallback)
